prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Companion trait selection sub-flow in adoption: Add an interactive personality trait choice component on the pet pick screen before creating the pet certificate. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (69.8% conversion) and long completion times; engaging interactive customization increases conversion.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop pet sanctuary preview new screen: Insert a new preview screen showcasing desktop sanctuary environments right before the final completion screen. (why: 3 support emails report pets not showing on desktop, and home new flow changes have shown high effectiveness (2 of 8 tests won).)
2: [choose_path, copy] Path selection creation method copy update: Update headline and body on path selection to give explicit clarity on quick preset vs custom photo creation. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s), indicating user confusion between adoption routes.)
3: [home, layout] Waiting screen status split layout redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout separating progress tracking from background pet setup information. (why: The waiting phase has high median (201s) and mean (2336s) times, causing drop-offs during pet rendering.)
4: [finish, hint] Account data control hint on finish screen: Add a hint on the home intro screen detailing account settings and data privacy management. (why: 4 support emails specifically requested account and personal data deletion transparency.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account sign in help and recovery hint: Add an explicit recovery guidance hint below sign-in options for users unable to find existing pet accounts. (why: Top support issue (8 emails) is pets missing after sign-in, needing clearer access to account recovery options.)
